replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body:
You should smooth these rivers out a bit, the World Edit is a bit evident.
Other than that, I guess it's alright. It doesn't really have anything that makes your map stand out as a whole, so I'd work on that. Something that makes the map unique and wanted, something other maps don't have! Any little things or details work, these special features are what makes maps amazing.
Good luck with it.
